title: Product Sans / Glyph Set
slide_intent: Expose character coverage before application so designers can check whether a typeface supports the required language and notation.
strategic_value: A broad, inspectable glyph inventory can support consistent Google branding across more written contexts.
demonstration: Two dense blue-on-white columns group letters, numerals, punctuation, symbols, alternates and ligatures at left and accented, Greek and Cyrillic forms at right.
practical_value: Check the actual required characters against the displayed set before committing a product name or localized phrase.

content_islands.name: Basic and feature glyphs
content_islands.spec: Stack labeled groups of Latin letters, numerals, symbols, alternates and ligatures in the left column.

content_islands.name: Language extensions
content_islands.spec: Use the right column for accented forms, Greek and Cyrillic specimens with their own labels.

reference_purposes.Expression: The inventory demonstrates the typeface across a wide range of glyph shapes.
reference_purposes.Application: Labeled character groups make supported characters and alternates inspectable.
